Overview

Mount Vernon is a city in NY with a population of 70,000. Westchester County city with the St. Paul’s Church National Historic Site. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees.
